env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go build -a -x -O=0 .
stderr '\-N \-l'
go build -a -gcflags=example.com/optlevelvalues=-m -O=0 .
! stderr 'inlining call to mid'

go build -a -x -O=1 .
! stderr 'inlbudget'
go build -a -gcflags=example.com/optlevelvalues=-m -O=1 .
stderr 'inlining call to mid'

logos build -a -x -O=s .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=15[ ,]'
go build -a -x -O=s .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=15[ ,]'
logos build -a -gcflags=example.com/optlevelvalues=-m -O=s .
! stderr 'inlining call to mid'
go build -a -gcflags=example.com/optlevelvalues=-m -O=s .
! stderr 'inlining call to mid'
cd mixed
logos build -a -x ./helper
stderr 'GOAMD64=.*v1.*helper'

logos build -o $WORK/base$GOEXE .
go version -m $WORK/base$GOEXE
stdout 'GOAMD64=v1'
cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/optlevelvalues

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func mid(x int) int {
	y := x + 11
	y = y*3 - x
	y ^= (x + 5) << 2
	y += y * x
	y -= (x ^ y) & 127
	y *= 3
	y += x * (y + 1)
	return y - (x * 7)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(mid(3))
}

-- mixed/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevelvalues/mixed

go 1.27

-- mixed/logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "baseline"

-- mixed/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}

-- mixed/helper/helper.go --
package helper

func Hello() {}
